$comment: Pinned SHA-256 for Kraken's official OHLCVT bulk archive (ADR-0020). full_parts and full_zip_sha256 are the values Kraken publishes (OHLCVT_Full_PARTS_SHA256SUMS.txt and the support article) and were reproduced locally on 2026-10-14. Kraken publishes no checksum for the quarterly incrementals: their hashes below are trust-on-first-download, pinned so a silently replaced file is detected. When Kraken ships a new release, update this file in its own commit after re-running `kraken_archive.py verify`.
